text:
maria: Heads-up: multiple vuln reports landed for Go deps used in runtime and control plane. grpc, golang.org/x/oauth2 and net/http header parsing have CVE reports. Need triage and patch schedule. https://example.com/cves (summary attached)

devon: Can you paste the CVE IDs and affected versions? I want to map to our go.mod snapshots.

maria: CVE-2025-1234 (x/oauth2) — token refresh race, high impact for servers that reuse client. Affects x/oauth2 <= v0.0.0-20240201
CVE-2025-2001 (grpc) — conn reset edge causing auth bypass in proxy setups, medium-high, affects grpc v1.55.0 and earlier in some configs
CVE-2025-2100 (net/http) — header parsing panic for crafted headers, low-med but DoS-ish; affects stdlib go1.19-1.21 when running with certain net/textproto combos

sam: OK. Quick priorities: x/oauth2 looks exploitable for our token refresh path on public API — high. grpc depends on connection state; need to check internal proxy layers. net/http is DoS risk for our edge workers but less likely immediate.

priya: I ran govulncheck locally against our main modules:
```
go list -m -json all | jq -r .Path,.Version
govulncheck ./...
```
Found x/oauth2 at v0.0.0-20240115 in our runtime/service-auth module, grpc at v1.54.2 in infra/proxy, stdlib is go1.20 in a few builds.

alex: Are there vendorized copies anywhere? Could be pinned in third_party libs.

maria: Not vendorized. Two places to patch: runtime-auth (uses oauth2 client for refresh) and edge-proxy (grpc). Plan suggestion:
- Immediate: bump x/oauth2 to patched rev and cut hotfix for runtime-auth canary (hosted only)
- Next 48h: upgrade grpc to nearest patched minor on infra/proxy and run soak on canary pool
- 72h: rebuild images with go1.21.7 patched stdlib for net/http AND add header parsing limiter middleware

devon: For Hosted API we should prioritize hotfix. Dedicated & Private customers: prepare advisory and backport guidance; some private on-prem might pin older deps — coordinate with account team.

sam: Agree. Add rolling canary strategy: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks and automatic rollback on 5xx or p50 latency + error rate delta. Use same rollout pipeline as last time.

priya: I'll open three PRs:
1) runtime-auth: replace directive in go.mod to patched x/oauth2 rev + unit test for token refresh race
2) infra/proxy: grpc bump + integration test script that runs grpc proxy e2e
3) build-images: upgrade base go image to patched go1.21.x and add middleware

Example go.mod change:
```
require golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.0.0-20240501
// replace old if needed
```

alex: Make sure to include `go mod tidy` and `go test ./...` and run `gocritic` lint. Also run performance smoke to check tail latency — oauth2 changes could affect connection reuse.

cve-bot: [automated] CVE entries linked: CVE-2025-1234, CVE-2025-2001, CVE-2025-2100. Severity labels set: HIGH, MEDIUM, MEDIUM respectively. Advisory IDs: ADV-2025-45, ADV-2025-46.

maria: Notes on pinning strategy: we should avoid long-term `replace` hacks. Prefer precise semver bumps in go.mod and add minimum version constraints in our internal module proxy (artifactory) to prevent old transitive pulls. For Private builds, provide a patchback bundle.

devon: Risk assessment for rollout:
- Hosted (public): High priority, hotpatch now, follow canary plan.
- Dedicated: Medium, schedule weekly maintenance windows; offer emergency patches on request.
- Private/on-prem: Low automation; prepare docs + patch tarball and offer remote assist if customer asks.

sam: I'll create the Trello/JIRA epic and link PRs. Triage owners: priya (runtime-auth), alex (infra/proxy), devon (release coord). Set ETA: hotfix in 8 hours, grpc bump in 36 hours, stdlib rebuild in 72 hours.

priya: Starting runtime-auth PR now. Will add a minimal repro test that simulates concurrent refresh.

alex: For infra/proxy, check gRPC keepalive and auth interceptor behavior; there was a previous workaround (fallback to plain HTTP/2) that may mask the issue — ensure regression tests cover it.

maria: Communication: I'll draft a short advisory for customers and internal KB entry with mitigations (temporary: enforce shorter token TTLs, rate-limit header parsing). Also coordinate with account teams for Private customers.

devon: After PRs merged, run the following in ci before canary:
```
make ci-image
./scripts/run-loadtest.sh --suite=smoke --duration=5m
```
If failures, auto rollback.

sam: Any blockers?

priya: Need a vet from QA to run the race-heavy test on CI. @maria can you add QA tag?

maria: Adding QA and SRE. @sre-team please prioritize the canary pool.

cve-bot: [note] Attachments: patch links and upstream PRs: https://go.pkg.dev/patches/123, https://github.com/grpc/grpc-go/pull/9999

alex: I'll prepare rollback playbook and a short SLA impact note for Sales.

maria: Great. I'll update the thread with PR links and the advisory draft. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
